The residue under your cursor is arginine (Arg) at position 85 in the dopamine transporter (SLC6A3). It is mutated to tryptophan (Trp) in the R85W variant. The residue is experimentally resolved in the structure 8Y2C and has recorded contacts with nearby residues (TYR A88, LEU A89, THR A316, GLN A317, PHE A320, ASP A476). ClinVar classifies this variant as likely pathogenic.

The variant R85W (p.Arg85Trp) is placed on the experimental structure 8Y2C (variantPlacement=true). The predicted model AF-Q01959-F1 is not used for variant placement. The residue is highlighted in the Protein World.

The question asks to show the coding sequence of FAAH2 on its transcript. The MANE Select transcript (ENST00000374900.5) is curated and available for display in DNA World. No experimental structure is available for FAAH2, so no transition to Protein World is possible.
